messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: smart-routing alert — elevated 5xxs for inference requests routed to eu-west-1 (fallback chain engaged)

sara (oncall): on it. looks like fallback policy started routing to a legacy quantized variant 'm-lq-2' in eu-west-1 — error rate spike ~35% for 10m

ajay: did someone manually pin or force-region recently?

sara (oncall): checking audit... hmm 1800453200 shows a manual override by 'deploy-bot' that applied a forced region tie-breaker: `route.policy.force_region=eu-west-1` for tenant-bursting rule. Intent was to reduce cross-region latency during maintenance.

maria (cs): heads up — 3 customers reported garbled outputs (structured-json failures) starting ~09:02 UTC, likely the same error signal. AcmePay flagged degraded results.

david (runtime): the variant 'm-lq-2' isn't fully compatible with the current tokenizer hyphen-handling; some requests hit a path that raises a decode exception and bubbles as 500. We didn't have an automatic compatibility check for fallback variants.

sara (oncall): ok immediate plan: 1) revert force_region override 2) unpin variant for smart fallback 3) if needed, route traffic to us-east-1 stable pool. paging ajay to take manual ops override.

ajay: taking handoff. executing preliminary rollback now.

ops-bot: Command executed by ajay: `redwoodctl routing rollback --change-id=chg-1800453200`

ops-bot: Rollback succeeded. New routing policy state: prefer-region unset, fallbacks allowed.

sara (oncall): monitoring metrics... errors dropped to baseline within ~90s but latency increased for a subset that was latency-optimized in eu-west-1. We have partial customer impact resolved.

david (runtime): follow-up: the rollback removed forced region but did not unpin the model variant in the cache for some workers — there's a cached model handle still pointing to m-lq-2. I can push a cache invalidation.

ajay: run the invalidation then — `redwoodctl runtime invalidate-cache --region eu-west-1 --model-handle=m-lq-2`

ops-bot: Command executed by ajay: `redwoodctl runtime invalidate-cache --region eu-west-1 --model-handle=m-lq-2`

ops-bot: Invalidation acknowledged; workers will reload next request.

maria (cs): which customers were affected? I saw AcmePay, NimbusRetail; both ondedicated/reserved settings. Any high-severity SLAs?

sara (oncall): AcmePay reported garbled json, severity S2. Nimbus had increased latencies but no functional failures. I will escalate to SEs for outreach.

david (runtime): root cause summary: manual force-region override created an unexpected routing tie-break where some requests selected a legacy fallback variant incompatible with production tokenization. Because we had a cached model handle and no explicit auto-unpin step in rollback, the system temporarily served incompatible variant until cache invalidation.

ajay: lessons learned / next actions: 1) add a preflight compatibility check on fallback variants (tokenizer/schema) 2) make rollback also trigger model-handle invalidation for affected pools 3) add guardrail in routing UI that warns when force-region may select legacy variants 4) add automatic customer impact annotation in the incident ticket.

sara (oncall): I'm creating the incident ticket now and will include timeline + commands. Also marking this incident as 'manual-override-induced' and tagging the routing policy as root cause.

maria (cs): I'll draft customer comms for AcmePay and Nimbus, include apology and ETA for follow-up.

ajay: one more note — during the incident there was a momentary fallback loop where eu-west-1 rejected some batches and routing retried to eu-west-1 due to stale affinity. We should add a short-circuit to avoid immediate re-fallback to the same region within 30s.

david (runtime): agreed. adding a cooldown to fallback selection. I'll open a PR for both compatibility checks + cooldowns.

sara (oncall): last check: errors stable, customer reports dwindling. I'm handing off to ajay for postmortem and remediation items. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

ajay: taking postmortem. I'll assign the action items and link PRs. Closing the page.

incident-bot: Incident note added to ticket INC-2028: manual routing override -> variant incompatibility -> cache residue -> rollback + cache invalidation resolved.

maria (cs): thanks — will ping when customer outreach is done.

sara (oncall): end of thread.
